text:
Mara: quick heads-up — started a thread on sparse crediting + inflight handshake edgecases. want to capture options before i file a mini-rfc
Sam: thanks — tl;dr problem?
Mara: short: when we compact credits we sample/emit sparse crediting events. during a replay/handshake we can get duplicates or split ownership that later causes double-billing or missed audit links.
Tony: ah yes, the late-arrival + lease-reacquire window. we've seen this in staging where a chunk gets credited twice after a consumer restart.
Lee: can you paste the failing trace?
Mara: pasted: ```
2024-04-03T14:22:11Z ERROR reconcile - duplicate credit found tenant=acme token_id=tok_1 shard=sh-22 attempt=3
2024-04-03T14:22:11Z INFO  handshake - reacquire lease for token_id=tok_1 owner=ingest-2
```
Sam: two axes: (A) make handshake idempotent + dedupe at finalizer; (B) change emitted credit shape to include provenance pointer so downstream audit can collapse.
Tony: (A) is cheaper short-term. add a deterministic credit fingerprint: `tenant|usage_root_id|sequence` and fast dedupe table.
Lee: worried about storage/TTL of dedupe table at scale. we already have per-shard compaction pressure.
Mara: right — option (B) is heavier but gives stronger auditability. include `provenance_id` on credits that points to canonical usage envelope; audits use that to join. downsides: we need provenance generation earlier and +/- refactor ingest contract.
Sam: another hybrid: emit sparse credits with `provenance_hint` (not full pointer) and finalizer enriches when it has canonical mapping. that keeps emitting fast but allows backfill to repair links.
Tony: love hybrid. but we must define failure semantics: if finalizer never enriches, downstream billing must still be correct. so credits need to be conservative (i.e., prefer undercharge when uncertain) or we need a reconciliation run.
Mara: +1. operationally, prefer reconciliation job that runs nightly fixing uncertain credits. add a metric `credits.enrichment_pending` to alert.
Lee: what about audit trail? finance needs stable IDs for every charged unit — can't rely on nightly fixes only. they want an append-only proof frame.
Sam: propose this API contract change: emitted credit shape => `{credit_id, tenant_id, amount, fingerprint, provenance_state}` where provenance_state in ["hint","canonical","repaired"]. auditors query the canonical mapping endpoint to resolve fingerprint -> canonical_provenance_id.
Mara: that lets billing show provisional entries until canonicalization completes. need UI/console flagging and SLA for enrichment.
Tony: implementation sketch: 1) fingerprint generation at ingress 2) fast-path credits emitted with state=hint 3) finalizer claims fingerprint and writes canonical_provenance_id + sets state=canonical 4) nightly reconcile marks remaining hints as repaired or creates manual corrections.
Mara: race we must handle: two finalizers claim same fingerprint concurrently and both write canonical rows. we need CAS/lease on fingerprint row or idempotent upsert with a chosen tie-breaker (lowest instance id).
Lee: CAS seems fine. we already have lease service used for handshakes; reuse it. ensure telemetry for lease contentions.
Sam: also add sequence of safe rollbacks: if we detect a duplicate charged from repaired step, emit compensating negative credit w/ reference to original provenance — keeps ledger auditable.
Tony: ops note: compaction and TTL: keep fingerprint->canonical map for 90 days, then snapshot and discard. finance compliance agreeable?
Lee: finance wants 1 year of traceability. 90 days won't fly. we need cold storage export to S3/warehouse for >90d retention. online map can be 90d.
Mara: agree. online map 90d for performance, export daily snapshots to warehouse for 12mo retention.
OpsBot: deploy-bot: rollout plan suggested: canary 10% of tenants on a 'hint' path, monitor `credits.duplicates`, `credits.enrichment_pending`, `billing.provisional_count` for 48h, then 50% then 100%.
Sam: next steps: I'll draft a short follow-up mini-rfc with shapes + finalizer CAS semantics + storage limits + export plan. want volunteers for review? @Tony @Lee
Tony: i'll review the CAS + finalizer code path.
Lee: i'll own retention/export and finance sync.
Mara: thanks all — putting draft in PR later today.
Sam: 👍 keep it brief, include sequence diagrams for normal vs restart/replay flow.
Mara: will do.
